comments.body:
Rank 8 Treasure Hunt:
15th Century 1, 3, 5; 16th Century 1, 3, 4

This has 3 relics. The most notable is the Emerald Tablet, an Alchemy +1 Accessory. They are part of the Truth of the Rumours (No.1) MA.

Leads to:
1. (G.T.)Small key for Lemegeton (R17 Clue)
2. Trismegistus for Emerald Tablet (R16 Clue)
3. Aim of the Sage for Picatrix (R13 Clue)
